name: codex-hypernexus
description: HyperNexus AI control plane for Codex — persistent L2 vector memory, MCP tool routing, agent dispatch, status/billing, and session management over stdio

interface.shortDescription: HyperNexus AI control plane with L2 memory, tool routing, agent dispatch, and billing
interface.longDescription: HyperNexus is a local AI control plane (Go kernel, port 7778) with persistent L2 vector memory, MCP tool routing, agent dispatch (chat/tool/swarm/A2A), system and billing status, and session management. Connected from Codex via MCP stdio: `hypernexus.exe mcp`.
